CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_account_deletion_requests()
 RETURNS SETOF account_deletion_requests
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select *
  from public.account_deletion_requests
  where public.life_pilot_is_admin()
    and status in ('pending', 'cancel_pending')
  order by
    case status when 'cancel_pending' then 0 else 1 end,
    coalesce(cancellation_requested_at, requested_at) desc;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_user_subscription_summaries()
 RETURNS TABLE(account text, active_entitlements bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with account_ids as (
    select s.user_id from public.user_subscriptions s
    union
    select e.user_id from public.user_subscription_entitlements e
  )
  select
    lower(u.email)::text as account,
    count(e.id) filter (
      where e.starts_at <= now() and e.ends_at > now()
    )::bigint as active_entitlements
  from account_ids accounts
  join auth.users u on u.id = accounts.user_id
  left join public.user_subscription_entitlements e
    on e.user_id = accounts.user_id
  where public.life_pilot_is_admin()
    and nullif(trim(u.email), '') is not null
  group by u.id, u.email
  order by lower(u.email);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fetch_user_progress(p_name text, p_game_type text, p_game_name text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, game_id uuid, score numeric, created_at timestamp with time zone, game_type text, game_name text, level integer, is_pass boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with ranked as (
    select
      gu.id,
      gu.name,
      gu.game_id,
      gu.score,
      gu.created_at,
      gl.game_type,
      gl.game_name,
      gl.level,
      gu.is_pass,
      row_number() over (
        partition by gl.level
        order by gu.created_at desc
      ) as rn
    from public.game_user gu
    join public.game_list gl
      on gl.id = gu.game_id
    where gu.owner_id = auth.uid()
      and lower(trim(gu.name)) =
          lower(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''))
      and lower(trim(p_name)) =
          lower(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''))
      and gl.game_type = p_game_type
      and gl.game_name = p_game_name
  )
  select
    id,
    name,
    game_id,
    score,
    created_at,
    game_type,
    game_name,
    level,
    is_pass
  from ranked
  where rn <= 3
  order by created_at desc;
$function$
